verdict.rationale: Weave documents a dedicated endpoint that ingests OTLP-formatted trace data into a project, and an OTel-compatible SDK, so sending traces over OpenTelemetry is directly supported alongside existing OTel pipelines. The evidence does not show Weave exporting or emitting its traces back out over OTLP, so the 'receive' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented OTLP export/egress of Weave traces to other backends, details on supported OTLP transports (gRPC vs HTTP) and semantic conventions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the OTLP ingest endpoint

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: This endpoint lets you send OTLP (OpenTelemetry Protocol) formatted trace data directly to your Weave project.
Weave supports import of OpenTelemetry compatible trace data through a dedicated endpoint.

Use this integration when you want to instrument your application with the OpenTelemetry standard and have those traces appear alongside your other Weave data, without replacing your existing OTel-based observability pipeline.
Trace and collect metrics about your agents built with popular SDKs and harnesses using Weave OTel-compatible SDK
